result.answer:
The API returned a single aggregated row for each metric rather than per-minute buckets, so there is no time-series granularity to identify spikes or compare their timing.

**No** — I cannot confirm a correlation. The tools summarize the entire 30-minute window into one aggregate value (driver P99 ≈ 296 ms; error rate field is absent/zero), which means there is no per-bucket data showing when or whether either metric spiked. Without a time-series response, a temporal correlation analysis is not possible with the available tooling.
